caption:
5 things clients check before they book your salon 👇

A new client decides in seconds if booking you is easy.

1. Prices by service
2. Real photos of your work
3. Who does what
4. Booking in 3 taps (most salons miss this one)
5. Where you are and how to park

If #4 is "send me a DM", you're losing late-night bookings.
